title: About
text:
About Me
  The longer version.

  
    
      
        I'm Gaurang — pronounced Gaw-rung. 
        I spent seven years building production software, and at some point I got 
        genuinely curious about what happens when engineering meets machine learning. 
        So I decided to find out properly, which is how I ended up at UBC doing a Master of Data Science.
      
      
        My engineering background is in Java microservices, CI/CD, and keeping systems running 
        under pressure. At UKG I grew from developer to lead, owning core services, 
        modernizing infrastructure, and mentoring junior engineers through the process. 
        Before that, Ericsson and Apple put me in environments where the margin for 
        error was essentially zero. At Ericsson I worked close to hardware, converting 
        MATLAB prototypes into production C++ for radio firmware deployed at live customer 
        sites. At Apple I optimized chipset drivers and cut automated test runtimes from 65 seconds 
        to 17 — small numbers with outsized impact on the team's velocity.
      
      
        What MDS has added is the ability to think statistically and work across the 
        full ML stack — from wrangling messy data and training models to 
        building reproducible pipelines and deploying interactive tools. 
        I care about models that work in production, not just ones that 
        look good in a notebook.
      
      
        For my capstone project, I partnered with  
        Educational Testing Service (ETS), to build an equity-focused 
        education dashboard processing over 1.7 million student records across 
        80+ countries. It's the kind of work where the technical decisions 
        directly shape how policymakers understand global education outcomes.
      
      
        I'm open to ML/AI engineering and data science roles — 
        hybrid or remote. If you're working on something interesting, 
        let's talk.

title: Projects
text:
Selected Projects
  Things I've built.

  

    
      Capstone · In Progress · 2026
      ETS Education Equity Dashboard
      
        Interactive data dashboard built in partnership with Educational Testing Service (ETS), 
        processing over 1.7M PISA student records across 80+ countries. 
        Surfaces full score distributions rather than misleading group averages, 
        enabling fairer, more nuanced conclusions for education policymakers.
      
      
        Python
        Streamlit
        Parquet
      
      
        ↗ Live App
        ↗ GitHub
      
    

    
      ML · LLM · 2025
      Local LLM & RAG Product Search
      
        Hybrid product search tool combining BM25 and semantic search through a RAG pipeline. 
        Uses a local LLM to ensure data privacy and efficient querying, 
        built over the Amazon product reviews dataset.
      
      
        Python
        LangChain
        Ollama
      
      
        ↗ GitHub
      
    

    
      Data Science · 2025
      Supply Chain Analytics Dashboard
      
        Interactive analytics dashboard built on a Kaggle supply chain dataset from 
        the fashion and beauty industry, exploring inventory patterns and 
        shipping cost drivers across product categories. Built end-to-end from 
        data wrangling through to deployment.
      
      
        Python
        Shiny
      
      
        ↗ Live App
        ↗ GitHub
      
    

    
      Python Package · 2025
      ez_df_data_validator
      
        Data validation Python package published to TestPyPI. 
        Includes a complete CI/CD workflow via GitHub Actions automating 
        unit testing, documentation generation, and publishing pipelines.
        Published at: test.pypi.org/project/ez_df_data_validator
      
      
        Python
        GitHub Actions
        TestPyPI
      
      
        ↗ GitHub
        ↗ Test PyPI
      
    

    
      Computer Vision · 2017
      Underwater Rover Object Detection
      
        Real-time computer vision pipeline for an underwater rover 
        to detect submerged golf balls using OpenCV. 
        Achieved sub-second detection latency on live video feed.
      
      
        Python
        OpenCV
      
      
        ↗ GitHub
